items.title: Bob Lovett Interview, 1949-04-01
items.q: Yes, I have with Bill Price and all those fellas playing with Lee Collins at the Victory Club, which was on North Clark Street.

ctx.x: G-E-R-O-U-L-D. And then I started a question, but I guess I laid you off a little bit. G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Were there other New Orleans men that you remember having played with around Chicago? G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Well, Lee Collins. Did we mention him? G-E-R-O-U-L-D. No, we haven't. And you said that you have a photograph of your band with Lee Collins.
G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Yes, I have with Bill Price and all those fellas playing with Lee Collins at the Victory Club, which was on North Clark Street. G-E-R-O-U-L-D. We used to go down there quite a lot.
G-E-R-O-U-L-D. It seemed to me that if anybody could sit in, there weren't many restrictions. G-E-R-O-U-L-D. That's right, yeah. G-E-R-O-U-L-D. So, Lee had what? Three, four pieces?
